category: shared seedbox (Arabic-language storefront; rTorrent/ruTorrent over FTP)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The entry product is SB-500: 500 GB, 1 Gbps shared, unlimited traffic, EUR 7 per month.
free_tier.notes: Tiers: SB-500 EUR 7, SB-1000 EUR 13, SB-1500 EUR 18 per month. A dedicated IP is EUR 2.5 per month extra.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a seedbox stores whatever fits in the plan's disk (500/1000/1500 GB).

retention.stated: Storage is the plan's disk and nothing on the page deletes on a timer; the client removes its own data.

egress.terms: Traffic is stated as unlimited on every shared and dedicated plan ('الترافيك: غير محدود'), and the connection is 1 Gbps shared.

interface_detail: rTorrent with the ruTorrent web UI on every plan. Shared plans expose FTP; dedicated plans add SSH, HTTP and SSHFS ('FTP / SSH / HTTP / SSHFS').
tooling: ruTorrent in a browser, FTP for transfer, SSH/SSHFS on dedicated plans. No rclone backend documented.
chaining: A seedbox does not resolve file-host links, but it removes a user's own line from the swarm: the torrent is fetched at 1 Gbps and pulled down over FTP, so the home connection only carries the finished file once.

limits.value: 1 Gbps shared across the users of the box on every shared plan

limits_note: Disk is the other ceiling: 500 GB on the entry plan against a client workload measured in terabytes, so the box is a staging area rather than storage.
binding_note: Traffic is not metered, so at 1 TiB/month nothing in the traffic terms fails; what fails is the disk (500 GB) and the shared gigabit, which is why the binding is throughput shaped by other tenants.

identity_cost.detail: An order account on the vendor's site; the checkout was not opened, so email as the minimum is inferred, not observed.

reliability_note: Shared gigabit and shared disk mean a neighbour's swarm sets the observed speed; the page publishes no uptime figure and no refund condition.
confidence_note: The plan table, the unlimited-traffic row and the interface rows were read today. The payment methods, the datacentre location and the delivery time were not on the page read.

evidence.proved: SB-500/1000/1500 at EUR 7/13/18 per month with 500/1000/1500 GB, 1 Gbps shared, unlimited traffic, rTorrent/ruTorrent and FTP; dedicated tiers from EUR 14 plus EUR 5 setup; dedicated IP EUR 2.5 per month

price_per_tb_month: EUR 7 per 500 GB-month at entry; traffic unmetered
notes: The only Arabic-language seedbox storefront found that publishes prices. Its relevance to retrieval is indirect: it seeds and stages, it does not unlock file hosts, so it composes with a debrid service rather than replacing one.
